            System tools for Optimizely Analytics
            
          </h1>

        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>System tools are built-in features that help Optimizely Opal take action. Each tool performs a specific task, such as creating a campaign, uploading files, or generating images. Think of tools like attachments on a Swiss Army knife. Each one has a distinct purpose that helps you get work done.</p><p><a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/33149092365709" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Analytics</a> provides system tools to help you with Analytics-related tasks, in addition to the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39340107628429" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">system tools</a> already available in Opal.</p><div class="note">Ask Opal what tools it has at any time. For example, enter <em>"Please list the tools you have with a brief description of what they do and the parameters"</em> into <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a>.</div><p>Click a tool's name to expand it and learn when to use it, its required and optional parameters, and example prompts for calling the tool. If you do not provide a required parameter, Opal prompts you for it.</p><h2 id="h_01K7QYG0Y4W7NPZWPKKTKG4NB2">Dashboard management tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K7QYG0Y4W7NPZWPKKTKG4NB2"></a></h2><details><summary><code>oa_find_dashboards</code> – Searches for dashboards in Optimizely Analytics using fuzzy search on dashboard names and semantic search on descriptions.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2d835567a3cce85af58f425d2cec83ba">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef6a0fc784b30fccdca98731bda03df54">Find, search for, or list dashboards in Optimizely Analytics. For example, <em>find dashboards</em>, <em>search for marketing dashboard</em>, <em>show me available dashboards</em>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b013c02f4ef040e5c8c2fbc0a2881fa">Locate a specific dashboard by name before adding explorations to it or analyzing its contents.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eee69d3e1c91ebb8933fc8dd3d4b32f38">Get an overview of all available dashboards and their descriptions.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e75316c293fa14f821f575d3dd041e27b">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e06f072f6a656d9548a45d07789dd1061">
<code>query</code> – A natural language search query to find dashboards. For example, <em>marketing overview</em>, <em>sales performance</em>, or <em>user engagement</em>. The search uses fuzzy matching on names and semantic matching on descriptions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ede5f178d2838c35bcfcf76b002b524ed">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7e1cb98d096d486f47b002e0795b649d">(Optional) <code>categories</code> – A list of category IDs to filter results by. When provided, only results that belong to at least one of the specified categories will be returned. Use the <code>oa_list_categories</code> tool to discover available categories and their IDs. Category filtering is handled entirely by this parameter. Do not include category names or references to categories in the <code>query</code> parameter. If the request is solely about filtering by category, use a broad <code>query</code> such as an empty string.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec740c0a4cfc919e5d56e5a19ce5c6c03">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed8464a615b8d898a120c74264465ad06"><em>Find dashboards related to "marketing overview".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3f11aae49d88911407146d132d7f74ee"><em>Show me all available dashboards.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e03f578094b943dd44fc04f46896a2649"><em>Search for a dashboard called "Q4 Sales Performance".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_create_dashboard</code> – Creates a new empty dashboard in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e32e9cc45574aec0b72f48faaf7254356">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edca1c033e05c759f12ce2dece8b9d4ca">Create a new dashboard to organize explorations and visualizations together.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef88e7939e15e54e06fb852fa51fac1ef">Set up a centralized reporting view before adding exploration tiles.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8254b1b26531f4825cb8554470da77d1">Build a custom dashboard for a specific project, team, or campaign.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee3985592ed2dd12349197595a4a6d40a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e34b5f292f53eabfc20d610e5088bc1a5">
<code>name</code> – A concise, descriptive name for the dashboard, intelligently generated by the agent.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efc5d0b9d554cac76de80d3669899ffd9">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebc356347637a2514433d3cca9dfbe741">(Optional) <code>description</code> – A brief description of what the dashboard displays, intelligently generated by the agent.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e14dc897dd0ab0e3588a2b610d50b4ddd">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb7a157f6c083935430f5ee9ff61f6ba0"><em>Create a new dashboard for our Q1 marketing campaign.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e484f90364953da2852af1f3381995d07"><em>Set up a dashboard called "User Engagement Overview".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e97020214a07449ff0f2c4d217ed11d06"><em>I need a new dashboard to track our conversion funnel metrics.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_add_explore_to_dashboard</code> – Adds an existing exploration as a tile to a dashboard in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eadcd1475c815629d9c1adb999e1cf4a1">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e44c2299756fb04d79fd39f6005c899e9">Add a saved or newly created exploration to an existing dashboard for centralized reporting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecd20b7533494212ed6c6b6845fd4fd19">Build a custom dashboard by adding multiple explorations as tiles.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec1978602cb3fc005a2db6de6153b043d">Attach a funnel, retention, or segmentation analysis to a dashboard after creating it.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e947797c7b9f17ecd67084c16487281ca">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e09a7b88a47718d4d55e779b73944581c">
<code>explore_id</code> – The unique identifier of the exploration to add (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). The source determines which field to use. For saved explores from <code>oa_find_explores</code>, use the <code>id</code> field directly. For draft explores from <code>oa_create_explore</code>, use the <code>explore.draftId</code> field (not <code>explore.id</code>). Do not pass dashboard IDs or experiment IDs here.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eade8c0530329f39730ffcc197e94d49a">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). Must be obtained from the <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> or <code>oa_create_dashboard</code> tools. This is a dashboard entity ID only. Do not pass experiment IDs, explore IDs, or any other entity type here. Doing so causes an error. If you have an experiment and need its Explore tab dashboard, use the <code>explores_dashboard_id</code> field from the <code>oa_find_experiments</code> tool instead.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5dbd564f3ec790599de4a27a954d5c71">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed9de5bd0d81080407a8ec205171d066b">(Optional) <code>tile_name</code> – A display name for the tile on the dashboard. If omitted, the exploration's name is used automatically.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebc9bae360a1509ebfc996986ebb90817">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eaf2ee8b38aa81e3bdea8f0a5336a7392"><em>Add the exploration I just created to my "Marketing Overview" dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec917cfceba4e65a8ae19c47fd7cf5d10"><em>Put the "Signup Funnel" exploration on my Q4 dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e59407463c6f196e699f2510940e42f65">
<em>Add explore </em><code><em>explore-123</em></code><em> to dashboard </em><code><em>dashboard-456</em></code><em> with the tile name "Weekly Conversions".</em>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_add_text_tile_to_dashboard</code> – Adds a text or header tile to a dashboard in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6a50dc1b7780969ab477e0467d14b157">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e27b8ef900cab0bb30bd6c672d47f7f1c">Create section headers or titles on a dashboard to organize content visually.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed40f865a76da25393f248e1a38860efd">Add descriptive text or annotations alongside data tiles on a dashboard.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecbd1ac5185513947f08228daead32ecb">Label groups of explorations within a dashboard layout.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaff2ad3b1ada0b93b4b1e1ea073f1ffd">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e047219203aa3f9b96670ade6b7f6bc61">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). Must be obtained from <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> or <code>oa_create_dashboard</code>. This is a dashboard entity ID only. Do not pass experiment IDs, explore IDs, or any other entity type here — doing so will cause an error. If you have an experiment and need its Explore tab dashboard, use the <code>explores_dashboard_id</code> field from the <code>oa_find_experiments</code> tool instead.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87ef905e0fe6abbd184244818de38f47">
<code>text</code> – The text content to display in the tile.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2d6107d02694f782d6c5add25e9aa1cc">(Optional) <code>format</code> – The text format or style: <code>h1</code> (large heading), <code>h2</code> (medium heading, default), <code>h3</code> (small heading), or <code>body</code> (paragraph text).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3a1c1c4395eac4d78679a09e9121de5f">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef65a2c8354200b713c7342ea941daa35">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7036f307aa05435ae4481270fd883211"><em>Add a heading "Conversion Metrics" to my marketing dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb2c3f73e48f4044933e5554395d3eb09"><em>Put a large title tile saying "Q1 2026 Performance" on my dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e88b306a69084b817535f2319d649315a"><em>Add a body text tile with a description of the dashboard's purpose.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_add_image_tile_to_dashboard</code> – Adds an image tile to a dashboard by downloading an image from a URL in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e05d9a4987d14477e08bd38939b73ba82">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e91fdf5f175774d93a11704b7887b4b27">Display screenshots, logos, or pictographic elements alongside metrics and data on a dashboard.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef5e3ea10469ca2fdaec9a06d4ae10f79">Add generated visualizations or infographics to a dashboard.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7eb782d96b26186ddcf88c5252a7e3e4">Include brand imagery or contextual photos on a reporting dashboard.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed3ad236836e25456a4d0f68e8023a810">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea9134b714620af2b93882decb75e59bf">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard to add the image tile to. Obtained from the <code>oa_create_dashboard</code> or <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> tools.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0fdc54e60bac17e645dfc4983b3317e4">
<code>image_url</code> – The URL of the image to download and add to the dashboard. Must be a publicly accessible URL pointing to an image file (<code>.jpg</code>, <code>.png</code>, <code>.gif</code>, or <code>.webp</code>). The image is downloaded, validated, and stored automatically. Maximum file size: 10MB.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87b43c35d417cfa2ebf7a98fb2ffd696">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7f798efedeea71b4d3f337891e43692e">(Optional) <code>title</code> – The title displayed above the image.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edb32d7951116024e3b1bb36221179438">(Optional) <code>caption</code> – A caption or description displayed with the image.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e13c45198bbc6b165739823f6bce336f1">(Optional) <code>height</code> – The tile height in dashboard grid units (default: 8, where each unit is 25 pixels). Width is determined by the dashboard grid layout and maintains the image aspect ratio based on object_fit. The tile will be appended to the bottom of the dashboard. Useful for tall images like infographics or compact images like logos.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef92072766b1432972fe8a3dd0f8af9a0">(Optional) <code>object_fit</code> – How the image fits within the tile. If not provided, front end applies default styling. Can be one of the following:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef6cd73475f8d358ca55c58a09db0c6ac">
<code>COVER</code> – Fills tile and crops excess.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef464c39d16512bc27bcab70ca0528e32">
<code>CONTAIN</code> – Fits inside tile maintaining aspect ratio.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2a46bf6ae40c0d89fe71e4e2f458461e">
<code>FILL</code> – Stretches to fill tile.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2a661fb42b55cb495ce8acbbea41979d">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e52dc29af2172d77babed310fde483a90">
<em>Add an image from </em><code><em>https://example.com/chart.png</em></code><em> to my marketing dashboard.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0a59c734c6cb688d2022a48559b23356"><em>Put our company logo on the "Q1 Report" dashboard with the title "Brand Header".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea42e170723d3423d943ca4c86dbfb4c0"><em>Add an infographic to my dashboard with a height of 12 grid units and use CONTAIN fit.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_arrange_dashboard_tiles</code> – Repositions and resizes tiles on a dashboard using a 24-column grid layout in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e54acf01c2d480c9450bbb0abbb42af90">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1892c085ee5dddd349bfdb5138aba543">Organize tiles into a visually appealing layout after adding explorations, text, or images to a dashboard.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e56ccb67b793a4a7aeaa2720989c54eb1">Resize tiles to give more or less space to specific explorations on a dashboard.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1b3419fbbcf7755014e52ca4a5e86fe7">Reposition tiles to create a structured, multi-row dashboard layout.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e32f2a3016368c79d9b61d56360859ce9">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1288b8bde31e6482371ebe6037e2f27c">
<code>tiles</code> – A list of tile layout objects. All tiles on the dashboard must be included. Each object must have the following: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e785d091375f69367d7029656668523ae">
<code>tile_id</code> (string) – The tile ID from the <code>oa_add_explore_to_dashboard</code> or <code>oa_explores_for_dashboard</code> tools.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e12262443e408dfb4a6de1a08c1a80d28">
<code>x</code> (integer) – Column start position (0–23).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="effd04839cf039d266129ef94d80fba02">
<code>y</code> (integer) – Row start position (0+).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eca9991a781983063e5630d5a1cf25c51">
<code>w</code> (integer) – Width in columns (1–24).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9cf20fa59b2f6fa72be3cf75b2e176c3">
<code>h</code> (integer) – Height in rows (typically 6–10 for explore tiles, 2–3 for text tiles). </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0dc63af59955ee86d13bad576d55a556">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). Must be obtained from the <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> or <code>oa_create_dashboard</code> tools. This is a dashboard entity ID only. Do not pass experiment IDs, explore IDs, or any other entity type here. Doing so causes an error. If you have an experiment and need its Explore tab dashboard, use the <code>explores_dashboard_id</code> field from the <code>oa_find_experiments</code> tool instead.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e303a66d821b1638e5b8162d6e3b3239b">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7ebd4b4b21e7f80279716fb2bc25c4e6">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8ecdd6a3c21c63f23be5c294896a8e14"><em>Arrange the tiles on my dashboard so the funnel is on top and the segmentation is below it.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb7d2150993ba483fedb5adfa5463ddeb"><em>Make all the tiles on my dashboard take up half the width, side by side.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e29df2ea33d0279d249a0490a6e51c0d1"><em>Reorganize my dashboard tiles into a 2-column layout.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_explores_for_dashboard</code> – Retrieves all explorations and filter tiles contained within a specific dashboard in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e86c44bf0ab32baa6aec503c1462c1e5d">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6eaa86d10cc5277b646ce8781c0ece31">See what explorations are on a dashboard before analyzing or modifying it.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec143f53b669e37a5b35a64385765c287">Discover the filter tiles applied to a dashboard so you can analyze explorations with the correct context.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee445619a6fbcd01a543fa485009ab9da">Get the tile IDs for dashboard tiles so you can rearrange them.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7a79313a0ef4997a24f7de3c39e6a520">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e96685552f8cc865526192fba065ab866">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). Must be obtained from the <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> or <code>oa_create_dashboard</code> tools. This is a dashboard entity ID only. Do not pass experiment IDs, explore IDs, or any other entity type here. Doing so causes an error. If you have an experiment and need its Explore tab dashboard, use the <code>explores_dashboard_id</code> field from the <code>oa_find_experiments</code> tool instead.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecf824b4bbd239a11c1fd7660bcbc9613">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecc678f0d3ab7e2fa8107387fc9d710f9">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8e5fc4f500e385b4256577cf1b0d7a47"><em>What explorations are on my "Marketing Overview" dashboard?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5499f380e87fbe05709a8e90b9815048"><em>Show me the contents of the "User Engagement" dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea92e70ed1cae9ebb25575e8c79b5a171"><em>List all the tiles on my Q4 dashboard.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_revert_dashboard_layout</code> – Reverts a dashboard layout to its previous state in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e74c906b3514261259057aa99fef61c67">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5cf796d7acb514c4d26fe035d17b6b4b">Undo the last tile arrangement on a dashboard and restore the previous layout.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e10969ba451862c9c3eaa26f941b05393">Revert an accidental or undesirable dashboard layout change.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e85e508c1ddf3e8347b612c141fda2767">Restore a dashboard's tile positions after experimenting with different arrangements.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e77338fee18c7d4cd6a326df93b20ab3c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7891857a3f38368a59a2cca4a6f2ad5">
<code>tiles</code> – The <code>previous_layout</code> value returned by the <code>oa_arrange_dashboard_tiles</code> tool. Contains the full tile position snapshot (<code>tile_id</code>, <code>x</code>, <code>y</code>, <code>w</code>, and <code>h</code>) before the last arrange. Pass this array directly as <code>tiles</code> to restore the previous layout.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5aaac3fbb4106c31f293041ae94e3b70">
<code>dashboard_id</code> – The unique identifier of the dashboard (format: <code><number>_<uuid></code>). Must be obtained from the <code>oa_find_dashboards</code> or <code>oa_create_dashboard</code> tools. This is a dashboard entity ID only. Do not pass experiment IDs, explore IDs, or any other entity type here. Doing so causes an error. If you have an experiment and need its Explore tab dashboard, use the <code>explores_dashboard_id</code> field from the <code>oa_find_experiments</code> tool instead.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0b4c113fd8acc33d1a0150b8aa7bb20f">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed4e8e5f3fe67f724f470ed80ec9ae07b">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb4ce0fee7b3a3787179d700a353e1753"><em>Undo the last layout change on my dashboard.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3424066305d46870eed78100a6b1d990"><em>Revert the dashboard tile arrangement to how it was before.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6ed059544538b4fc67980dc4c9e0ee6c"><em>The new layout doesn't look right — restore the previous one.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h2 id="h_01KGQGHJ3MV9RYN48JDBK54GFF">Data retrieval and app configuration tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KGQGHJ3MV9RYN48JDBK54GFF"></a></h2><details><summary><code>oa_confirm_app</code> – Confirms your app selection for the current Optimizely Analytics session.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecfd299621835cf28fd365c2e270fc2d1">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb5242069d8e8e44b65d31054e7860dc7">Confirm an app selection after you picks one from the <code>oa_list_apps</code> list.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8a21f17cd9f3b8c17f867f5a70393374">Switch to a different app when <code>oa_list_apps</code> auto-resolved an app but you hinted at a different one.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecbb682786f83ce79b5f4ce4e0e937721">Set or remove a default app for future sessions when you explicitly request it.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed00fdc7094eb26dbb1b86d690d788b4c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0a3fcb6598caf95843c8e5ea732f4ed3">
<code>appid</code> – The UUID of the selected app, taken from the hidden <code>appid</code> field in the <code>oa_list_apps</code> tools response. This must be the UUID value (for example, <code>2705840d-23ca-404a-9c23-207dd31af320</code>), not the app name.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaf2027887179031d2e601a8afe8d9198">(Optional) <code>set_as_default</code> – Controls your default app preference: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e68d80500b1e5915ebb99bd791a5cc88f">
<code>true</code> saves this app as your default for future sessions. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e27d2bcd908185dd8b91c84ed38db29a6">
<code>false</code> removes this app as your default (if it is currently the default).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6bd9314288ba0136435eccfcc74bf101">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e13e42f0e0002ffc27f18356df3a3a90d"><em>Use the "Production" app for this session.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e009eed851401c11d20613f0fd3c49ee7"><em>Set my default app to "Marketing Analytics".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebccc00cda86939e73d6f6794b7482665"><em>Remove my default app setting.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_find_cohorts</code> – Finds and lists saved cohorts (also called saved audiences or user segments) in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaff82b831f71ae0c8846ed3567d0cdc3">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e54a53df7c79372808d5518f0aacaa8bf">Find, list, or discover existing cohorts, audiences, or segments in Optimizely Analytics.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e798c65e4c7662d359a54a46f1e00fdfc">See what saved audiences are available for use in explorations or scorecards.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4ae75a8d16a2cfa78e35ad987601d0a">Search for specific user groups like <code>VIP users</code>, <code>premium customers</code>, or <code>churned users</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efc46461e13adfa627e49f44b99538e0b">Browse all available cohorts when no specific query is needed.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea4220a4fd92a6d73487df934e253e17c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb1d5ff7d7f9e6446bbdbd58d7b6ed545">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <code>appid</code> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value. You can often find it in the URL of your Optimizely Analytics project (signified by <code>?app=</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e72eb26543942ce25eec91f206796c1d4">(Optional) <code>query</code> – A natural language description or name of the cohort to search for. For example,<code>"premium users"</code> or <code>VIP</code>. If not provided, returns all cohorts.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ddebe690842c670d0995bc00aa166d4">(Optional) <code>limit</code> – Maximum number of cohorts to return (default 100).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e00f4f02d3cfedd25ced0b55c22f56af4">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec7f1cf78139c068d2d358223aa55d27d"><em>Show me all available cohorts.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7dd901e9f19a879127f1a1cdd3d1cc8a"><em>Find cohorts related to "premium customers".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7af4f594919f97f8cc1e1245c52415d8"><em>List saved audiences that match "churned users".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebf251e922d8f59a988f81abce855506f"><em>What user segments are available in my analytics app?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>oa_find_column_values</code> – Fetches distinct real values for a specific column or property in Optimizely Analytics.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e18f7b7a7054a55fc367315eede9ec115">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed4e89cda1bd4402f1f9f852d03cd6e06">Discover what values exist in a column before using them in a filter (for example, if the column is <code>Company</code>, this returns values like <code>Canva Pty Ltd</code>, <code>Google</code>, and <code>Stripe</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecdf4a29aa60648f810b8ec52a226d71f">Verify the exact stored value for your filter input, since filter values are case-sensitive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4d7780d8d98b5f02620f1dd64e8bdf5">Search for specific column values by a partial string match.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e25eb5484241770bf2e6220452dd8106e">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed5384d979c51526eea10ab82c9e56eb8">
<code>column_id</code> – The column reference to fetch values for. An entity reference object with the following: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6d76ae6ed86e677c4306a32aac9b8e1d">
<code>entity_id</code> (string) – The <code>id</code> field from an entity returned by the <code>oa_find_entities</code> tool</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1f7c546e4e8502198e3583bf79833984">(Optional) <code>field_path</code> (string) – Targets a JSON subfield using dot notation (for example, <code>plan.name</code> or <code>revenue</code>). Use <code>field_path</code> only when the entity is a JSON-typed column whose subfields you discovered using the <code>oa_find_entities</code> tool.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5c4bf0212fb22f13b3d58706f4d36286">(Optional) <code>appid</code> – The ID of your Optimizely Analytics application for context. Opal uses the <span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;"></span><span id="MathJax-Element-1-Frame" class="mjx-chtml MathJax_CHTML" tabindex="0" style="font-size: 117%; position: relative;" data-mathml="<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mi>a</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>&#x3C0;</mi><mi>d</mi></mstyle></math>" role="presentation"><span id="MJXc-Node-1" class="mjx-math" aria-hidden="true"><span id="MJXc-Node-2" class="mjx-mrow"><span id="MJXc-Node-3" class="mjx-mstyle"><span id="MJXc-Node-4" class="mjx-mrow"><span id="MJXc-Node-5" class="mjx-mi"><span class="mjx-char MJXc-TeX-math-I" style="padding-top: 0.216em; padding-bottom: 0.27em;">a</span></span><span id="MJXc-Node-6" class="mjx-mi"><span class="mjx-char MJXc-TeX-math-I" style="padding-top: 0.216em; padding-bottom: 0.483em;">p</span></span><span id="MJXc-Node-7" class="mjx-mi"><span class="mjx-char MJXc-TeX-math-I" style="padding-top: 0.216em; padding-bottom: 0.27em; padding-right: 0.003em;">π</span></span><span id="MJXc-Node-8" class="mjx-mi"><span class="mjx-char MJXc-TeX-math-I" style="padding-top: 0.483em; padding-bottom: 0.27em; padding-right: 0.003em;">d</span></span></span></span></span></span><span class="MJX_Assistive_MathML" role="presentation"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mi>a</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>π</mi><mi>d</mi></mstyle></math></span></span><script type="math/asciimath" id="MathJax-Element-1">appid</script> from your system context if available, or explicitly asks you for this value.
